meta.scope: Colombia batch 1 — Phase 0+1. Core national statistical system from DANE catalogue top-down: institutional identity, national accounts anchors, CPI, labour (GEIH), monetary poverty, population, and Banco de la República. Definition locked.

candidates.title: Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística (DANE) — institutional statistical identity
candidates.description: National statistical office of Colombia. Produces the core official statistics (prices, labour force, poverty, national accounts inputs, census, etc.) and coordinates the national statistical system.
referenced_by: All major DANE programme methodologies and press releases
Banco de la República statistical publications that cite DANE sources
Comité de Expertos en Pobreza joint statements
candidates.notes: Institutional parent node for Colombian official statistics. Continuously cited as the producer of the principal economic and social series.

candidates.title: Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) / Consumer Price Index
candidates.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a representative basket of goods and services. National coverage with city-level detail for major urban centres.
candidates.notes: Flagship price statistic. July 2026: monthly variation 0.17%, year-to-date 4.94%, annual 6.03%. Direct input into monetary-policy analysis by the Banco de la República and into the updating of poverty lines.

candidates.title: Gran Encuesta Integrada de Hogares (GEIH) / Great Integrated Household Survey
candidates.description: Continuous household survey that is the primary source for labour-market indicators (employment, unemployment, informality, underemployment) and for the income data used in monetary-poverty measurement. National, urban-rural, regional and capital-city domains.
candidates.notes: Central social and labour survey. Moving-quarter and monthly releases. Official source for both labour statistics and the income side of monetary poverty and inequality (Gini). Microdata regularly disseminated.

candidates.title: Pobreza monetaria y pobreza monetaria extrema / Monetary poverty
candidates.publisher: DANE + Comité de Expertos en Pobreza
candidates.description: Official income-poverty and extreme-poverty incidence, calculated by comparing household per-capita income (from GEIH, augmented with administrative transfers) with nationally defined poverty lines. Annual publication with urban/rural and city breakdowns.
candidates.notes: Headline social indicator. 2025 results published June 2026 with joint DANE–Expert Committee statement. Poverty lines updated with IPC; income concept includes labour, transfers and other sources. Series have undergone methodological empalmes after GEIH frame changes.

candidates.title: Líneas de pobreza monetaria y pobreza extrema
candidates.description: Monetary values of the poverty and extreme-poverty lines (per capita and for reference households), updated with the IPC and differentiated by geographic domain.
candidates.notes: Direct input into the poverty measurement. 2025 national per-capita extreme-poverty line ~$236,580; poverty line ~$482,041 (monthly). Domain-specific lines published for cabeceras and centros poblados/rural disperso.

candidates.title: Cuentas Nacionales / National Accounts of Colombia
candidates.description: Full system of national accounts producing GDP by production, expenditure and income, supply-and-use tables and institutional sector accounts. Quarterly and annual releases.
candidates.notes: Core macroeconomic statistical system. DANE is the primary compiler (unlike Chile where the central bank leads). Quarterly GDP and annual institutional accounts are the headline products.

candidates.title: Censo Nacional de Población y Vivienda / National Population and Housing Census
candidates.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline, sampling frames for household surveys, and small-area population estimates.
candidates.notes: Foundational demographic product. Continuously cited by GEIH design, poverty analysis and departmental statistical work. Latest major census cycle and subsequent projections are the current reference.

candidates.title: Banco de la República — statistical publications (monetary, external, inflation)
candidates.description: Central-bank statistical output covering monetary aggregates, balance of payments, international reserves, exchange rates, and inflation analysis. Complements DANE’s real-sector and price statistics.
candidates.notes: In the Colombian division of labour DANE leads national accounts, prices and labour; the Banco de la República leads monetary, external and financial statistics and conducts inflation-targeting policy.

candidates.title: Índice de Producción Industrial (IPI) / Industrial Production Index
candidates.description: Monthly volume index of industrial production (manufacturing, mining, electricity). Principal short-term activity indicator for the industrial sector.
candidates.notes: Core short-term industrial indicator. Complements the broader activity measures and feeds into quarterly national accounts.

candidates.title: Coeficiente de Gini / Income inequality
candidates.description: Official Gini coefficient of income inequality, calculated from the same GEIH income concept used for monetary poverty. Published annually with the poverty results.
candidates.notes: Companion inequality indicator to the poverty series. Released jointly with monetary poverty and extreme poverty under the Expert Committee process.

proposed_edges.basis: Monetary poverty is calculated from GEIH household income data (augmented with administrative transfers).
Poverty status is determined by comparing per-capita income with the official poverty and extreme-poverty lines.
Poverty lines are updated with the IPC.
The Gini coefficient is computed from the same income distribution underlying the poverty estimates.
GEIH is a core continuous survey of DANE.
IPC is produced and disseminated by DANE.
National accounts are compiled by DANE.
